description.zh: 按 STR、INT、WIS、DEX、CON、CHA 各掷 3d6。之后可选职业并按其限制调整主属性。
description.en: Roll 3d6 for STR, INT, WIS, DEX, CON, CHA in order. You may then choose a class and make its permitted prime-requisite exchanges.

notes.zh: 每次从允许的属性减 2 换主属性加 1；供出属性不低于 9，目标不超过 18。盗贼不能降低 STR。
notes.en: Trade 2 eligible donor points for 1 prime-requisite point; donor minimum 9, target maximum 18. Thieves cannot lower STR.

notes.zh: 低属性重建须由主持人许可；程序不会自动重掷。
notes.en: Replacing a poor character needs referee permission; no automatic rerolls.

notices.zh: 这是属性生成结果，不是完整人物卡。
notices.en: This is ability generation, not a complete character sheet.

notices.zh: 尚未选择职业或进行主属性调整。

description.en: Roll 3d6 for STR, INT, WIS, CON, DEX, CHA, in that order. The original procedure has the referee roll.

notes.zh: 仅生成六项基础属性；主属性经验换算尚未应用。
notes.en: Generates the six base scores only; prime-requisite XP conversion is not applied.

description.en: Assign six totals from the highest three of four d6. No default low-score reroll rule.

name.zh: 方法 II：十二取最高六个
name.en: Method II: best six of twelve

description.zh: 掷十二次 3d6，保留最高六个总和，再自由分配。
description.en: Keep the highest six of twelve 3d6 totals; assign freely.

source.title: AD&D 1E Dungeon Masters Guide
source.location: p.11; reproduced in Dragon, Let the Good Dice Roll

description.zh: 按 STR（力量）、AGI（敏捷）、STA（耐力）、PER（人格）、INT（智力）、LCK（幸运）依次各掷 3d6，保留全部骰子，不交换结果。仅生成六属性及调整值，不是完整零级人物卡。
description.en: Roll 3d6 in order for STR (Strength), AGI (Agility), STA (Stamina), PER (Personality), INT (Intelligence), LCK (Luck). Keep all dice; no swapping. Generates abilities and modifiers only, not a complete level-0 character.

source.title: Dungeon Crawl Classics RPG Quick Start Guide (June 2011)

notes.en: Does not generate class, occupation, hit points, money, equipment or birth augur.
